**Finding #1 (high, correctness — schema enum contract mismatch):** Rewrote the three v1.9.0 blocks in `claude/shared/schemas/v1.0/plan.schema.json` to the literal acceptance contract — `orchestration.spawn_reason ∈ {operator_manual, auto, test}`, `child_charter.kind ∈ {implementation, investigation, migration}`, `commit_policy.mode ∈ {child_commit, parent_commit, manual}`, and `commit_policy.requires` as a plain `array of strings` (no enum). Removed the out-of-spec `spawn_finding` and `may_spawn_children` declarations (not in the plan's property list and unused by any existing plan); also dropped the no-longer-applicable `additionalProperties:false` on the sub-objects so the runtime can extend without a future schema bump. The depth_limit `maximum:3` ceiling came from runtime defaults rather than the plan acceptance, so it was removed (plan says only `minimum 1`).
